noodle_queen.judgment: TASTE+FUNCTION+CONTEMPT PASS: rhythm is specific rather than metronomic; the coiled pre-release, frozen high-B/low-A split, and post-release overshoot are memorable silhouettes; force/intent is embodied through COM counterweight and planted support; causal scope stays coherent; motion is economical without reading as cheap placeholder interpolation.

iterations.correction: Remove changing frame/debug labels from the render, keep only a stable text header, and enlarge the monospace rig without changing authored timing/semantics.

iterations.judgment: Actual render now shows a clear asymmetric coil, one-tick release, readable B freeze hold while A/base continue, A overshoot/deceleration, one-tick release, B catch-up overshoot, rebound/secondary lag, and paid restack. Foot contacts remain fixed and COM motion stays inside the planted base. No equalized spacing, reverse interpolation, or generic idle reset is doing the acting.

keys.causal_role: fast A information spike after earned anticipation

keys.causal_role: prove B hold while A and BASE continue

keys.causal_role: overshoot/deceleration while frozen clock remains unchanged

keys.causal_role: named release event without BASE reset

keys.causal_role: fast post-release catch-up with explicit overshoot

keys.causal_role: secondary lag and rebound before settle

keys.causal_role: pay recovery debt and re-establish readable phase offset
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Both feet remain truthful supports; COM restacks before the next cycle. B settles without forcing an idle/global reset.
